title: Chapter 397 Life And Death Together
content:
Chapter 397 Life And Death Together

He was wearing a mysterious robe, with cumbersome runes on it, and his appearance was no different from Lu Daosheng's life, but there was a bit more noble between his eyebrows.

At this moment, the two of them looked at each other, and everything was indifferent.

"I believe that you should have guessed something until now. After all, with your ice and snow cleverness, it is impossible to be so stupid."

Lu Daosheng, who walked out of the statue, smiled indifferently, and his words were full of confidence.

When Lu Daosheng heard this, he felt a little unnatural in his face, "Can I understand that you are praising yourself?"

Hearing this, the phantom suddenly burst into laughter.

"Yes, I'm just praising myself."

"You and I are of the same origin, but now you are not complete. Now, it is the day when it is time to combine."

Lu Daosheng's expression suddenly became solemn. He looked at himself in front of him and asked the question he wanted to ask the most.

"After joining you, am I still me?"

The phantom naturally knew what Lu Daosheng was saying, "You can rest assured that you are me, and I am you, so how can you have the second consciousness?"

After the two of them are combined, their memories will be shared, and Lu Daosheng will know everything about him.

Lu Daosheng naturally couldn't find it.

Now that I knew that the thing I feared most would not happen, I immediately breathed a sigh of relief.

He looked at the phantom and spoke directly, "How to combine?"

The phantom did not speak, but told Lu Daosheng with his actions.

I saw the phantom walking directly towards Lu Daosheng.

The moment the two of them came into contact, the entire ancient city began to shake.

At this moment, the road roared.

The phantom began to turn into starlight, all pouring into Lu Daosheng's body.

Lu Daosheng's eyes closed slightly, and the breath in his body began to gradually change.

Above the city gate, a big word suddenly appeared in the huge plaque.

shortage!

Desert city, desert city.

I don’t know how long the ancient city has existed and how long it has been sleeping here. Now, I finally come back to life.

Vitality emerged in the city, and phantoms that reached the sky appeared from ancient times.

They are tall towers and ancient trees that reach the sky.

All the most precious treasures in the world have appeared in the ancient city.

If an ordinary strong man is here, he will be stunned, because there is only one reason why these treasures can be manifested in the ancient city, that is, those treasures have taken root in this ancient city and existed for endless years.

And now, where have all those treasures gone?

Deep in the ancient city, on a desolate land.

The earth trembled, and terrifying auras began to emerge.

The next moment, as a beam of light gushed out from the depths of the ground, it seemed like a hornet's nest was poked, and beams of light gushed out.

Immediately afterwards, a phantom appeared in each beam of light.

After a brief confusion, these phantoms opened their eyes and looked at the center of the city.

Their eyes were vicissitudes and filled with tears. After the silence, they suddenly shouted in unison: "We wait, welcome the city lord back!"

"Welcome to the city lord back!"

The huge roar kept echoing from this ancient city.

In the big temple, Lu Daosheng's eyes suddenly opened.

He let out a long breath of turbid air, and his eyes became wet, but more so, mixed with complex emotions.

Everything is known.

And at this moment, the familiar mechanical sound in the body sounded again.

[The system task ended successfully. 】

【Bee ———— 】

Then, there was no sound in the system.

"Haha, I'm really slow to go this trip, but it adds some fun."

Lu Daosheng's voice was hoarse, he looked up at the ceiling, and two lines of tears slid from the flawless face.

At this moment, he already knew that the system was his own power.

Unlimited upgrades are still exaggerated after all.

Now he is in the strongest state, looking at the whole world, no one can beat him.

But, he has no enemies.

His trouble is how to save the world.

In this fallen world, every world is suffering from an erased process.

Lu Daosheng must stop all this.

In his memory, he had worked hard for it, but unfortunately, he failed.

He cannot stop the world from collapsing.

So he did many other things.

Cultivate students, create power, and collect treasures.

It’s naturally not boring to do these things.

But he is ready to live a second life.

Life in the second life must be smooth and worry-free. It is best to be able to marry a wife and raise a child.

Therefore, he turned all his strength and the rare treasures he collected into a system.

However, the system found him a little late, but it had no effect.

Now, he has done all this.

He died without regrets!

But now he doesn't want to die!

People are so greedy. They now have a beautiful family and a force they need to protect. They don’t want the world to collapse.

There will definitely be a solution.

Lu Daosheng was once again full of hope as if he first learned that the world collapsed in his previous life.

Perhaps, this is why he wants to live out his second life.

The next moment, Lu Daosheng trembled all over and his figure disappeared from the spot.

When it appeared again, Lu Daosheng appeared directly above the ancient city.

His figure was extremely huge, covering almost the entire ancient city.

"It's the city lord!"

The phantoms who had just woken up were so excited that they burst into tears and their voices were choked when they saw Lu Daosheng's figure.

Lu Daosheng's eyes also fell on these phantoms.

He naturally recognized these phantoms, all of which were the subordinates he trained in his previous life.

Even though endless years have passed, these subordinates have successfully survived to this day by relying on the means left by themselves.

In response, Lu Daosheng waved his hand and endless breath of life poured down.

The phantom stained by these breaths of life suddenly burst out in the body, and blood and flesh were growing out. In just a moment, a brand new body appeared in front of everyone.

After a moment, these phantoms returned to their former glory. They all looked excited and knelt down to Lu Daosheng, "Thank you for your blessings!"

"All up, let you wait for a long time."

Lu Daosheng's face was soft and he spoke softly.

It must be difficult to endure for so many years.

These people naturally heard what Lu Daosheng meant.

"Mr. Lord, I was just a bandit, just to fill my stomach. It was you who changed me. I, Liu Si, once swore that I would be with you, will be with you, and I, Liu Si, would be with you. This was the case before, but it will still be like this in the future!"

A unshaven man said with a fist.

The rest of the people didn't speak, but their firm eyes were filled with answers.

"Okay, OK, OK."

Lu Daosheng said three good things in a row. At this moment, he felt that his whole body was full of strength.

That's responsibility.

"I, Lu Daosheng, swear here, and I will take you through the crisis!"
